name: Cummins diesel generator sets (Quiet Diesel, Standard Diesel, Centum Series)
description: All major components (engine, alternator, controls) manufactured, tested and serviced by Cummins; Cummins Power Suite tool for design/installation. Tier 4F certified rental solutions noted. Centum S17 Series 600-1000 kW 60 Hz referenced in related news item on same site.
